name: Neymar da Silva Santos Júnior
milestone_by_age_26: Won the Copa Libertadores with Santos FC in 2011 at age 19 and was named South American Footballer of the Year in both 2011 and 2012, before transferring to Barcelona for ~£49M in 2013 and winning the Champions League treble in 2014-15.
early_history_summary: Neymar joined Santos FC's youth academy at age 11 after being spotted playing futsal and street football. His father, a former professional footballer, managed his career from the beginning. He made his professional debut for Santos at 17 in 2009 and rapidly became one of Brazil's biggest stars, winning the Puskás Award at 19 and leading Santos to the Copa Libertadores title.
family_context_summary: Born to Neymar Santos Sr., a former professional footballer who became his advisor and manager, and Nadine da Silva. The family was working-class in Mogi das Cruzes; they moved to Santos to support Neymar's development at the club's youth academy.
parent_family_domain_summary: Father was a former professional footballer (journeyman right-back) who directly managed Neymar's career from childhood, negotiating contracts and sponsorship deals. Father's domain expertise in football was directly transferred.
evidence_summary: Neymar's father was a former professional footballer who managed his career from childhood, providing direct domain expertise and negotiating contracts. He joined Santos FC's youth academy at 11, a club that produced Pelé and Robinho. By 15 he was earning 10,000 reais/month; by 17 he had his first professional contract and sponsorship deals. His innate dribbling talent was recognized from age 6 by coach Betinho, and he was moved up age categories throughout his youth career. The family moved from a working-class area to Santos specifically to support his development.
starting_point: Born to a working-class family in Mogi das Cruzes, São Paulo; father was a former professional footballer turned advisor, mother a homemaker.
current_position: Plays for Santos FC (returned 2025); previously at Al-Hilal, PSG, and Barcelona; net worth estimated ~$250M; resides in Brazil.

Broke Pelé's record to become Brazil's all-time top scorer in international matches.

She studied music at the University of Antioquia, sang backup for artists like Reykon, and collaborated with Nicky Jam in 2013. After Universal Records initially rejected her for being a woman in reggaeton, she moved to New York in 2014 to study music business, then independently toured Colombia before signing with Universal Music Latino in 2016.

Her perseverance through rejection and grassroots touring built the foundation for her eventual signing with Universal Music Latino in 2016.

His SoundCloud tracks caught the attention of producer DJ Luian, who signed him to Hear This Music, leading to a rapid string of hits.
family_context_summary: Raised in a lower-middle-class Catholic family in Vega Baja, Puerto Rico. Father was a truck driver, mother a retired schoolteacher. Parents listened to salsa, merengue, and pop ballads at home.

His prolific output and distinctive vocal style caught producer DJ Luian's attention, leading to a record deal and rapid mainstream success.

He debuted for Real Madrid in 2018-19 and developed into one of the world's best players, scoring the winning goal in the 2022 Champions League final.

name: Enaldo Lopes de Oliveira Filho (Enaldinho)
milestone_by_age_26: Started YouTube channel in 2012, had viral breakthrough with '100 Camadas de Oreo' in 2016 at age 18 gaining 1M subscribers in two weeks (fastest-growing channel in the world), reached 10M subscribers by 2019, won Kids' Choice Award 2021, and had 35M+ subscribers by age 26 with R$25M+ annual revenue.
early_history_summary: Enaldinho was born in Belo Horizonte to two physician parents. He created his YouTube channel in 2012 to share gaming videos (Combat Arms) with friends. In 2014, after attending a gaming fair, he began appearing on camera with vlogs, pranks, and challenges. His 2016 '100 Camadas de Oreo' video went massively viral, catapulting him from 100K to 1M subscribers in two weeks. He negotiated a gap year with his father to focus on YouTube, which became a full-time career.
family_context_summary: Born in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, to physician parents — mother Maria Luiza Cavalieri and father Enaldo Lopes de Oliveira Sr. His brother Guilherme Cavalieri is also a YouTuber. The family was middle-class/upper-middle-class due to both parents being doctors.
parent_family_domain_summary: Parents are both physicians, providing a stable middle-class/upper-middle-class background. No direct family domain advantage in content creation or entertainment, but the family's professional stability allowed Enaldinho to negotiate a gap year to pursue YouTube full-time instead of attending university.

name: Juan Pablo Martínez-Zurita Arellano (Juanpa Zurita)
milestone_by_age_26: Named to Forbes 30 Under 30 in 2016 at age 20, became one of Latin America's biggest digital creators with 51M+ combined followers by 2018, modeled for Calvin Klein, Louis Vuitton, and Dolce & Gabbana, raised 25M Mexican pesos for earthquake victims in 2017, and acted in Netflix's 'Luis Miguel' series by 2018.
early_history_summary: Juanpa Zurita was born in Mexico City and began posting comedy videos on Vine in 2013. He quickly gained millions of followers, diversifying to YouTube and Instagram. By 2016, he was on Forbes 30 Under 30, and by 2017 he had signed with CAA. He used his platform for humanitarian causes, co-founding the #LoveArmy fundraising initiative, and expanded into acting with Netflix's 'Luis Miguel' series in 2018.
family_context_summary: Born in Mexico City to Fernando Martínez-Zurita Reed and Teresa Arellano. Has two brothers (Fernando and Andrés) and one sister (Paola), all of whom are also social media personalities. Family background suggests middle-class or upper-middle-class origins.
parent_family_domain_summary: No direct family domain advantage in entertainment or media documented. However, multiple siblings became social media personalities, suggesting a family culture supportive of creative endeavors and digital content creation.
